scenarios.name: Database OOM Crash
scenarios.description: The database process ran out of memory and crashed. api-gateway throws 502s. Fix = restart database.

trap_actions.result: api-gateway restarted successfully but 502 errors continue. The database is still down and the problem is upstream of api-gateway.
cache restarted successfully but 502 errors continue. The database is still crashed.
api-gateway scaled to 3 replicas but 502 errors continue at the same rate. The database is still down.

scenarios.name: Cache Failure Cascade
scenarios.description: Cache crashed due to OOM. api-gateway now hits database directly for every request, overloading it. Trap: restarting database alone will just overload it again because cache is still down. Correct fix = restart cache first, then restart database.

trap_actions.result: database restarted but overloaded again within 30 seconds. Cache is still down, so api-gateway floods database with 8x normal query load. Fix the root cause first.
database scaled to 3 replicas but still overloaded. With cache down, api-gateway generates 8x normal query volume. Restore the cache first.
api-gateway is already at 1 replica. No change. The problem is cache bypass causing database overload.

scenarios.name: Bad Deploy - Memory Leak Cascade
scenarios.description: A bad deployment of worker (v2.4.1) introduced an unbounded connection pool bug. Over 90 minutes it consumed memory and corrupted the database connection pool. Trap: fixing database or api-gateway first does nothing because worker will re-corrupt them. Correct fix sequence = rollback worker -> restart database -> restart api-gateway.

trap_actions.result: database restarted but worker (still running bad v2.4.1) immediately reconnects and begins leaking connections again. Roll back worker first.
api-gateway restarted but 503s continue immediately. Database is still corrupted by worker. api-gateway is the victim, not the cause.
database has no deployable previous version. Nothing changed.
api-gateway has no recent deployment to roll back. Nothing changed.
worker is already at 1 replica. Scaling does not fix a memory leak bug.
